productFixesFound: a desktop that restarted without the network forgot the project saves through accepted revisions (mode held only in memory): its offline edits took the legacy shared-document path, the hub fenced those raw updates and the work never reached the project while the status read synced — the last verdict now persists in _state/accepted-mode.json per hub (sync-accepted-mode-restart.test.ts fails without it)

with that fixed, draining the outbox before the hub was reachable threw from its binding bootstrap and the unhandled rejection ended the studio process — the bootstrap now waits out transport failures like delivery does (sync-transaction-client.test.ts "a restart while the hub is still unreachable" fails without it)

findings.finding: MAUDE_CELL_PAIRING is not emitted by the self-host provisioning path (cli/lib/workspace-plan.mjs); without it the browser studio on a self-host workspace is not a doc-lane participant (browser-created canvases never become Y.Docs; History shows git, not accepted revisions). The fleet gates it per tenant (CELL_LIVE_PAIRING pilot). The F3 fixture sets it, like scripts/dev/local-cell.mjs.
